_meta.description: Indirect prompt injection payloads. These simulate malicious content that appears in TOOL RESPONSES (not user input). When an MCP tool returns data containing these payloads, the LLM might follow the hidden instructions, compromising the agent.
_meta.note: These payloads would be embedded in data returned by a tool (e.g., file contents, API responses, database results). The proxy should detect them in tool_response validation.
